source.text:
Hey HN, Misho & Lukas here. We're two data science students from ETH Zurich and we love building stuff with AI.

We just built an agent that automates tasks for you in your own Chrome. You give it a task ("launch a Google Ads campaign", "build a post-purchase email flow in Klaviyo"), it asks a few questions, then clicks and types its way through it.

We want to turn this into a startup. We started with marketing tasks because Misho worked on marketing automation software before.

Demo: https://youtu.be/d1_LeuYmKrA

How it works: - The agent runs on AWS on OpenAI's open-source Codex runtime. - Playwright drives your Chrome through our extension. No API integrations, and no passwords leave your browser. If you can click it, it can click it. - Approvals and Stop are enforced on the server, not with "please ask first" in a prompt. We don't trust the model with that.

And we're kind of stuck. The agent works, and we think it's pretty cool... but we just can't figure out who it's for. We tried six different landing pages with Google Ads for each... and spent $214 on 26 clicks, zero sign-ups :(

So, help us out please: - What's the browser chore you'd happily never do again? - Have you ever paid a VA or a freelancer just to set up or click through some mundane task for you (e.g. setting up a Shopify integration)? What was it? - Roast the landing page... It's clearly not converting.

If you want to try it: app.shoppilot.ch. Happy to hear any thoughts.
